items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Walter Deku; the name is only introduced by the interviewer as part of a band lineup description.

ctx.x: Oh, nothing else but Dixieland music. Did your father play any instrument? I know your uncle was a violin player. You liked them low about... My uncle was a violin player. My uncle was a violin player. Well, my daddy was a... He started trumpet. But he never did violin. I know. I know. Anyone else in the family that played? Of course, we know your brother. Oh, yeah. I have a wonderful brother, Bonnie Biggoin. He's the top musician. Were there any other members of the family, any other brothers or sister that…
They had Walter Deku on piano. Emile Biggoin on violin. And they had Bill Matthews was playing drum.

And they had Joe Howard playing trumpet. Was there a clarinet did you mention? Yes. No. No. Who was the clarinet? Who was the clarinet? Was there a clarinet did you mention? The clarinet player was uh, The clarinet player was uh, Louis Nelson. Biggoin. Oh yeah. Oh yeah. Can you tell us anything about your, anything else about your uncle? Uh, when did he die about? I don't even know. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No.…
